services.desc: ABOUT SPRING/EARLY SUMMER ONLY SOMES BAR, CA Put-in: USFS Butler Ledge river access Take-out: Oak Bottom or Big Ike Difficulty: Class IV Length: 7 miles Known locally as “the slamming salmon” this spring time run is epic! Butler is the true classic run of the Cal-Salmon, as it has a general big water class IV character with two larger rapids sprinkled in. The Butler Ledge run, our guides’ favorite, starts off fast and furious with the class III-IV “miracle mile” and continuous constant action. services.desc: Our Farm to Table Dinner Cruises showcase the two things we are most passionate about: pristine rivers and local organic California cuisine. Join us for a one-of-a-kind experience that begins with either: A bunch of exciting whitewater rapids on the Upper Trinity River Pigeon Point Section, and ends with an equally beautiful farm to table style dinner served on the beach. Or, a relaxing Scenic Class ll Float followed by dinner served to you riverside on a sandy beach. These trips are ideal for couples and groups wanting a more romantic and/or relaxing river experience. All of the produce served is local, organic, and cooked fresh on-site.
